get.description:
Free text plus filters parsed out of it. Parsed filters come back as chips with their
position in `q`, so the client removes a chip by cutting that span out of the query.
Items for a surface, each with the reason it came back.

get.description: Server-sent events: `item` events carry {id, status, step} as each workflow step lands.

post.description:
Re-run one step at its current version across all items.

Enrichment steps (`summary`, `tags`, `entities`, `embeddings`, `images`, `dedup`) re-run
for every item. Workflow steps (`extract`, `snapshot`...) re-run only for items whose last
run used an older version, unless `force` is set. Search fields refresh afterwards.
